title: How Power Platform helps businesses build AI into existing apps
summary: See how Microsoft Power Platform, with Microsoft Power Apps and Copilot Studio, help organizations drive AI transformation at PPCC 2026.
body_markdown:
The next generation of business applications will not simply include AI. They will bring people, agents, apps, and automations together to understand goals, make decisions, and act. But most organizations aren’t starting their AI transformation from a blank page. They already have applications, data, automations, and business processes that employees rely on every day. The opportunity is to build on those investments, making existing solutions more intelligent while accelerating the creation of what comes next.


[Microsoft Power Platform](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform) and[Microsoft Power Apps](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/products/power-apps) are making that transformation practical today. Organizations can bring people, agents, apps, and automations together without rebuilding every solution from scratch. They can evolve the applications their businesses already use and trust, extend established processes with AI, and create new experiences on a governed foundation.


[Build AI-powered solutions](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/products/power-apps)


## Turn ideas into business solutions faster


AI is changing not only what business applications can do, but also how they are created. With hybrid authoring in Power Apps, people can work alongside agents and choose the experience that best matches their skills and goals, from coding agents and[Copilot Cowork](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/features/cowork) to Power Apps Studio. The resulting solutions can then be edited and managed in Power Apps.


For business leaders, the value is straightforward: more people can contribute to solving business problems, ideas can move from concept to solution faster, and IT can maintain the governance and control needed to scale with confidence.


## Bring AI into the flow of work


Once deployed, these applications can deliver even more value through[Microsoft Copilot](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot) . In model-driven and canvas apps, users can interact with business data using natural language to uncover insights, create communications, and take action within the flow of work.


Instead of treating AI as a separate destination, Copilot and Power Platform bring productivity capabilities and business data into the applications and processes where work already happens, helping organizations turn AI into meaningful business outcomes.

## See the future in action at PPCC 2026


At the[Power Platform Community Conference (PPCC)](https://powerplatformconf.com/) , you can see how these capabilities come together and explore what they could mean for your organization. Come see me and Leon Welicki share what’s new with Power Platform and[Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/products/copilot-studio) on Tuesday, October 27 at 4:00 PM Pacific Time (UTC-7), and build your agenda around the business outcomes you want to achieve:


- **Turn ideas into solutions faster:**[Author Your Way: Agentic Authoring Across Power Platform](https://powerplatformconf.com/sessions/Author-Your-Way%3A-Agentic-Authoring-Across-Power-Platform)
- **Reimagine how work gets done:**[Work, Reimagined: Copilot, Cowork & the Power Platform](https://powerplatformconf.com/sessions/Work%2C-Reimagined%3A-Copilot%2C-Cowork-%26-the-Power-Platform)
- **Scale intelligent automation:**[Automation at Scale: Workflows in the Agentic Era](https://powerplatformconf.com/sessions/Automation-at-Scale%3A-Workflows-in-the-Agentic-Era)
- **Extend what your agents can do:**[Empower Your Agent to Do More: What’s New in Agent Capabilities](https://powerplatformconf.com/sessions/Empower-Your-Agent-to-Do-More%3A-What%27s-New-in-Agent-Capabilities)


[Charles Lamanna](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/blog/author/charles-lamanna/) , Executive Vice President, Copilot, Agents, and Platform at Microsoft, will open the conference with a vision for what comes next. Throughout PPCC 2026, you’ll see how that vision becomes reality through intelligent apps, agents, automation, and the solutions you create.


Your next chapter of AI transformation starts with the applications, data, processes, and expertise your organization already has. Join us in Las Vegas, October 27-29, 2026. We can’t wait to meet with you and be inspired by what you build next.
